text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
I'm not at all surprised to see that
Mahiru's adored by so many people.
I mean, it's only natural for her...
choice_data_list: Her adult charm's getting stronger, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いろんな人に慕われてるマヒルちゃんを見ても、
不思議と全然驚かないのよね。
マヒルちゃんなら当然、
っていうか……

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
When I see her smiling face, I know in my heart that everything's gonna
be all right. Anyone who harms such a wonderful person will feel my
woolly wrath.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マヒルちゃんの笑顔を見てると、
きっと大丈夫だ、
って安心できるのよね。
そんなマヒルちゃんを傷つける人は
許せないわ。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say people love her just because she's cute, but
she is adorable. I bet she'd say \"it's 'cause of my mature allure,\"
or something like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かわいいから慕われてるわけじゃないと思うけど、
確かにかわいいわよね。
マヒルちゃんは
大人の魅力が～
って言うでしょうけど。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Oh, r-right, sorry. For a moment there, I had to think twice
about what you meant. Yeah, being able to do lots of things for
others as a matter of course is certainly an appealing, mature trait.
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………え？
　あ、
ご、
ごめんなさい。
一瞬何を言ってるのか
分からなくて。
けど、
人のために
いろいろなことを当たり前に
できるっていうのは
確かに大人の魅力ね。
